Name: Dark Red Hair Leah for Content Patcher
Author: saltedcoffii
Description:
This mod is an adaptation of Satadoros' Dark red hair Leah mod for content patcher. Content patcher mods are better for many reasons. See the dangers of
using an XNB mod here: https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods

This mod edits the sprite and portrait of Leah to give Leah darker hair.
Also, check config.json for more revealing options!

Please let me know about any bugs/errors.

Thank you so much for downloading! To add, drop into Mods folder. Make sure you have at least Stardew Valley 1.4.0, SMAPI 3.0.0, and Content Patcher1.11.0 installed! Like the mod? Don't forget to endorse!

Downloads.Description: Gives Leah darker red hair! Doesn't she look so much better?
